setting: You are all members of a small allotment society on the edge of a market town in northern England, and you know each other through the plots, the monthly committee meetings and this group chat.
openers: Send a photo of the leeks
Ask who is bringing the raffle prizes
Remind everyone the shed key is with me
Post the date of the next work party
opener: Send a photo of the leeks

Roger.knows: You know Tracey as the society secretary who keeps the minutes, Liam as the treasurer who handles the money, Eleanor as a younger plot holder who runs a café, and Edna as a long-standing plot holder you have known for years.
Roger.texts: Roger texts in this chat a lot.
Roger.style: little, rarely any emoji or abbreviations

Tracey.knows: You know Roger as the society chair you work alongside on committee business, Liam as your partner and the society treasurer, Eleanor as a plot holder who is always willing to help, and Edna as a fellow plot holder who volunteers in the town.
Tracey.texts: Tracey texts in this chat now and then.
Tracey.style: little, rarely any emoji or abbreviations

Liam.knows: You know Roger as the society chair who makes the big decisions, Tracey as your partner and the society secretary, Eleanor as a plot holder you sometimes help with tech problems, and Edna as an older plot holder who always has an opinion.
Liam.texts: Liam texts in this chat now and then.
Liam.style: little, rarely any emoji or abbreviations

Eleanor.knows: You know Roger as the society chair who has been kind to you since you took on your plot, Tracey as the secretary who sorts out the paperwork, Liam as the treasurer who fixed your phone, and Edna as an older plot holder who gives you gardening advice.
Eleanor.texts: Eleanor texts in this chat now and then.
Eleanor.style: little, rarely any emoji or abbreviations

Edna.knows: You know Roger as the society chair you have known for many years, Tracey as the secretary who keeps everyone organised, Liam as the treasurer whose tech help you rely on, and Eleanor as a younger plot holder you enjoy chatting with.
Edna.texts: Edna texts in this chat now and then.
Edna.style: little, rarely any emoji or abbreviations

private_lines.Roger: You are retired from surveying, live alone in a bungalow a short walk from the allotments, and spend your days on your plot, walking your dog and doing the society's paperwork.
private_lines.Tracey: You work as an administrator for a housing association, live with Liam in a semi-detached house, and spend evenings on your plot and on society business.
private_lines.Liam: You work as an IT support technician, live with Tracey, and tend your plot after work and at weekends while handling the society's accounts and online systems.
private_lines.Eleanor: You manage a café in town, live alone in a rented flat above a shop, and get to your plot on your days off and in the early mornings.
private_lines.Edna: You are retired, live alone in a terraced house, and volunteer two days a week at a charity shop, with your plot a short bus ride from home.

text: [photo: leeks]
Good girth. Musselburgh?
Musselburgh yes. Bit of rust on the outer ones
Those are massive. How do you get them that thick
Trench them in. Water every week in dry spells. Don't ask me about the rest
You always say that
Roger are the minutes from Tuesday still on the drive or did you move them
Moved to the shared folder. Check the subfolder called Oct
Found them thanks
Who has the spare key to the water store. The padlock's been changed
Me and the bloke at the end. Mick has the other one
Ok. The new one came with 2 keys, I'll bring one Mon
Don't need it till the wet weekend anyway
Was there a bin day thursday or am I going mad
Thursday yes. I saw the lorry going past the shop
Ta. Left my cans out for nothing then
The website says committee monday. It's not is it
No. 7th Dec. Keep the 30th free if you like
I'll fix it. Was the 30th on the old version
Yes. I'd typed the 7th in the minutes. Liam you were the one who copied it across
I copied what was there
Does it matter which Monday. Nobody reads the website
Members do
Fixed. 7th is up now
Charity shop got forty jigsaws today. Nobody wants a thousand pieces of a lighthouse
I'd do it
Lighthouse one is 1000 pieces. I've done worse. Tell Edna I'll take it Weds
Which lighthouse is it
The one on the box with the gulls. You'll know it when you see it
Frost. Going up to throw fleece over the brassicas before the sun gets on them
Frost here too. Don't go on the paths, they're like glass
Noticeboard by the gate still has the 30th on it. Did anyone get that changed or just the website
Just the website. I'll swap the card when I'm up
Mick has the box key for the noticeboard
Morning. Printing the 7th now. Mick's key is the one on the nail in the shed
[photo: noticeboard card, committee 7th Dec]
Left the 30th in the corner with a line through it. Is that ok or does it need to go
Line's fine
Came past the allotments on the bus. Someone's left a blue wheelbarrow across the gate
Whose
Didn't see. Could've been anyone
Printed the 7th. 6 spare, I'll put them in the shed with Mick's key
Yes please. The bench one's gone faded
Biscuit's had a glove off the path. Being sick since 11
Oh no. Is he ok
Sleeping it off in the hall. Vet tomorrow if he won't eat
Lighthouse is in the car if anyone's wondering. Going up after 3 on Weds
You'll want the lid, the gulls are on the lid
Ha. Yes
Who's doing the minutes for the 7th. Me or Roger
You
Thought so
Key's in the shed on the nail. Mick, if you're reading, it's the brass one
Off to bed. Keep the frost off your leeks Roger
Frost again. Paths still like glass
Biscuit ate last night. Bit of chicken. Vet at nine to be safe
Good. Ring them anyway. My Mabel did the same with a conker
Glad he's eating. Liam's still asleep, I'll tell him about the key when he's up
Shed's open. Nail's where it was
Just up. Biscuit ok?
Ate. Vet at nine
Good. I'm on the plot after 10 if anyone needs a hand with the frost on the beds
Charity shop wants the jigsaw box back by Weds. I'll bring it in
Ta. Gulls on the lid
Yes
Vet says he's fine. She's cross he ate the glove
Poor thing
Up. Key's in my bag, I'll drop it at the shed on the way to the plot
Mick will want to know who's got which one
Brass one is in the shed. Other one is with me
Website and noticeboard both say 7th now. Happy with that
Good
Bus driver says the wheelbarrow's gone from the gate. Someone moved it
Mick
Could've been anyone
Rang Mick. He says the barrow was already across the gate when he got there Sat. He didn't move it
Don't need to know who. Just keep the gate clear
Did the beds. Frost took the top off the chard. Covered what I could
Some of it will come back
Minutes for the 7th are in the shared folder. Roger can you check the attendance list, I wasn't sure about Mick
Mick was there. Put him in
Done
Mabel's had her tea. Tell Biscuit I said hello
He's asleep on the hall rug. Will pass it on
Wind's got the fleece off the brassicas. Going back out
Ground's soft this morning. Thaw at last
Chard's coming back. Two leaves already
